notes.title: McKinsey Case Interview Prep Notes
notes.content:
Case Interview Coaching Notes (for mentees)

Structured approach:
1. Clarify the question (30 sec)
2. Structure the problem (2 min)
3. Analyze key drivers (5-8 min)
4. Quantitative reasoning (5 min)
5. Synthesize recommendation (2 min)

Common frameworks:
- Profitability: Revenue (price x volume) vs Costs (fixed + variable)
- Market entry: Market size, competition, capabilities, economics
- Growth: Organic (existing products/markets) vs Inorganic (M&A/new markets)
- Operations: Process mapping, bottleneck analysis, benchmarking

Common mistakes:
- Jumping to solutions without structure
- Ignoring the 'so what' of each analysis
- Poor math (practice mental math!)
- Not asking clarifying questions

Resources:
- Case in Point (Marc Cosentino)
- McKinsey internal case library
- Practice with peers (2-3x per week minimum)

notes.title: Nordstrom — Store Associate Change Management
notes.content:
Change Management Plan — Store Associate Mobile Tools
Draft v1 — March 2026

Problem: 40% store manager resistance to new mobile productivity tools

Root cause analysis:
1. Poor training (2-hour session is insufficient for non-technical staff)
2. Tool complexity (too many features launched at once)
3. Fear of surveillance (associates think it's tracking their performance)
4. No clear incentive to adopt

Proposed approach:
- Phase 1 (April): Simplified tool with 3 core features only
- Phase 2 (May): Add features based on associate feedback
- Phase 3 (June): Full feature set with opt-in advanced features

Training redesign:
- 5-day onboarding (not 2 hours)
- Peer champions model: 2 enthusiastic associates per store as coaches
- Video tutorials + in-app guidance
- Weekly Q&A sessions with tech team

Incentives:
- Gamification: Points for tool usage → rewards
- Early adopter recognition program
- $500 bonus for peer champions (20 stores x 2 = 40 champions = $20K)

Success metrics:
- Target: 80% daily active usage within 60 days of launch
- Current: 45% in pilot stores
- NPS from associates: Target 30+ (current: 12)
